goal: Session-view agent messages render thinking, text, and tool_use content blocks as readable entries instead of raw JSON dicts, even when blocks are serialized without a type key.

references: packages/flywheel-core/src/flywheel_core/invoker.py:343 _serialize_sdk_message -- serializes SDK content blocks via dataclass fields only, so persisted ThinkingBlock dicts look like {'thinking': ..., 'signature': ...} and ToolUseBlock dicts like {'id': ..., 'name': ..., 'input': ...} with no 'type' key

packages/flywheel/src/flywheel/_session.py:304 _classify_assistant_block -- dispatches on block.get('type'), so every real persisted block falls through to the raw _short(block) fallback the operator sees as JSON noise
constraints: Classification must handle both shapes: blocks with an explicit 'type' key (current test fixtures) and the typeless dataclass-field shape _serialize_sdk_message actually persists -- already-stored transcripts must render correctly without any data migration
An empty thinking block (thinking == '' alongside a signature) must produce no transcript line, and signature values must never be rendered in any branch
Tool-use blocks must keep the existing collapsed tool(name) summary form produced by _summarise_tool_input
Add regression tests whose assistant payloads are built exactly as _serialize_sdk_message emits them (no 'type' key), so the producer/consumer shape mismatch can never silently regress
Commit with a Conventional Commits message before emitting intent=verify
non_goals: Do not change the SdkMessageRecord persistence schema or migrate stored rows
Do not redesign tool_result rendering or the other EntryKind branches
edge_cases: Thinking block with non-empty thinking text plus a signature: render the thinking text under the agent(thinking) header, drop the signature
Block matching no known shape (no text, thinking, or tool_use markers): keep the stringified fallback so unknown content never drops silently
